INSERT INTO resume_analysis (
  parsing_id,
  candidate_name,
  candidate_email,
  years_experience,
  seniority_level,
  education_level,
  employability_score,
  top_skills,
  certifications,
  jobs_analyzed,
  best_match_score,
  best_match_job,
  strong_fits_count,
  skill_gaps,
  full_resume_data,
  job_matching_results,
  processing_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.parsing_id }}',
  '{{ $json.candidate_summary.name }}',
  '{{ $json.candidate_summary.email }}',
  {{ $json.candidate_summary.years_experience }},
  '{{ $json.candidate_summary.seniority_level }}',
  '{{ $json.candidate_summary.education }}',
  {{ $json.employability_score }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.candidate_summary.top_skills) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.candidate_summary.certifications) }}',
  {{ $json.job_matching.jobs_analyzed }},
  {{ $json.job_matching.best_match?.match_score || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.job_matching.best_match?.job_title || "" }}',
  {{ $json.job_matching.strong_fits_count }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.recommendations.skill_gaps) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.full_resume_data) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.job_matching.all_matches) }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.processing_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
